capabilities: Run multiple AI agent chats in tabs
Mention notes and attachments as context
Review and approve file edits and commands
Start saved prompts from browser links or scripts
extras: Documentation is hosted separately; the README claims 6,000+ tests and a token benchmark.
intentEvidence: Agent Console is based on Agent Client by @RAIT-09, originally released under Apache-2.0.
motivation: Most AI agents start every chat knowing nothing about you; Agent Console runs agents inside the vault so notes can provide context.
problem: Most AI agents start every chat knowing nothing about the user's vault, so notes cannot serve as context or be updated by the agent.

relations.evidence: Agent Console is based on Agent Client by @RAIT-09, originally released under Apache-2.0.
Codex – the Agent Client Protocol Codex adapter
Kiro CLI – Amazon’s agent; Agent Console runs its V3 engine, or V2 on older versions
OpenCode – open-source agent; runs local models via ollama
Antigravity CLI – Google’s command-line agent, successor to Gemini CLI
Gemini CLI – Google’s earlier command-line agent (legacy)

requires.name: AI agent CLI (Claude Code, Codex, Kiro CLI, OpenCode, Antigravity CLI, Gemini CLI, or custom ACP agent)
API keys required by the chosen agent

summary: AI agent console that runs external coding agents inside an Obsidian vault, with note context, multiple tabs, and approval prompts.
